verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded payments platform, so questions about fund custody, yield on balances and segregation from the provider's own accounts are fair to ask of it. The evidence pack only covers deposit frequency settings, amount splits and billing profiles. None of it explains where in-flight or held funds sit, whether balances earn yield, or how platform and merchant funds are kept separate from Rainforest's own accounts.

support.subject: As a finance lead, platform funds have a home — clarity on where in-flight and held funds sit, whether balances earn yield, and how money is segregated from the provider's own accounts
